summaryEvents.text: The agent checks the new cube positions and plans to confirm contact before release.
The gripper is aligned with the purple cube. The agent plans to grasp it and move above the green cube.
The cube stayed on the table despite the gripper reporting success. The agent reopens and lowers the fingers for another grasp.
The next grasp lifts the cube clear. The agent raises it for clearance and moves toward the green cube.
The cubes are aligned with a small gap. The agent lowers carefully while keeping the gripper closed.
Force feedback confirms contact between the cubes. The agent prepares to release and check stability.
